# MapAnything backbone for StreamRig

[中文](MAPANYTHING_README_CN.md) · [Project home](../../README.md)

This directory contains the reduced MapAnything v1.0.1 backbone needed to
precompute StreamRig's frozen information-sharing features. Install it from
the StreamRig repository root with `pip install -e ./third_party/mapanything`.

The upstream project is [facebookresearch/map-anything](https://github.com/facebookresearch/map-anything).
See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the exact upstream revision, changes and pruning scope,
and [LICENSE](LICENSE) for its Apache 2.0 license. StreamRig's root README
contains the matching checkpoint and full preprocessing instructions.
